agent_fit_phrase.validation_rule: Approved enum phrase such as first_fit or also_fit; renderer owns copy.

agent_name.validation_rule: Official routine or agent name from product knowledge.

agent_pain_resolved.validation_rule: Concrete pain this routine/agent helps with, grounded in diagnostic facts.

agent_practical_action.validation_rule: Practical action the studio can understand without technical SaaS terms.

agent_recommendation_reason.validation_rule: Reason this routine/agent fits the diagnostic evidence.

answer_feedback.validation_rule: Grounded reflection on the immediately previous diagnostic answer; not generic filler and not mechanical repetition.

clarification_question.validation_rule: One neutral clarification question; no product claim, no side effect.

crm_base_recommendation.validation_rule: Grounded recommendation for organizing the base/routine before agents; no technical CRM jargon unless the lead used it.

demo_status.validation_rule: Persisted demo state: not_offered, offered, viewed_or_asked, or reacted_positive.

first_name.validation_rule: Only a verified real person first name; never a studio name, handle, phone, internal reliability label, or unverified profile value.

official_demo_link.validation_rule: Official demo URL from product knowledge; never invented or shortened ad hoc.

operational_first_step.validation_rule: First practical operational step tied to the lead's stated priority.

pain_context_human.validation_rule: Practical studio-owner reading grounded in diagnostic facts or the lead's own pain/context message.

plan_fit_context.validation_rule: Lead-provided context used only to explain why fit needs diagnostic evidence.

recommended_plan_or_range.validation_rule: Official plan or range from product knowledge; never inferred from one number without diagnostic evidence.
